feedback_policy: Diagnostic base inputs only. Hidden plus inputs, expectations and outcomes never enter model messages.
primary_metric: current-round full_pass on base and held-out mini tests
initial_program_policy: One fresh initial program per model/task shared by four arms; no initial-outcome-based task selection.
request_budget: One seed plus four rounds per each of four arms = 17 requests per model/task; maximum 5576 before transport retries.
history_policy: Full arm-specific message history for all revision arms; resample uses only the original task prompt.
